headlines.title: Special Report: Vatican says Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgery
headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV was diagnosed with lung cancer and had the lower lobe of his right lung removed, the Vatican announced. NBC News' Anne Thompson explains why the operation was characterized as "radical" and Claudio Lavanga reports on the expected recovery timeline.

headlines.title: Bank of America ordered to pay historic $1.2 billion over alleged sanctions law violations
headlines.description: The fine is the third-highest penalty ever issued by the Treasury Department, which found that the bank failed to report billions in suspicious transactions.

headlines.title: Trump rally protester attacked in act of ‘senseless’ political violence, Ohio mayor says
headlines.description: At least two men attending President Donald Trump’s rally in Ohio attacked a female protester in a “senseless” confrontation decried by the mayor of Youngstown on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Trump attacks Rep. Ilhan Omar and Senate hopeful Abdul El-Sayed at Ohio rally
headlines.description: The crowd chanted “deport” at several points as Trump denigrated Omar, who was born in Somalia and immigrated to the U.S., and El-Sayed, who was born in Michigan.

headlines.title: Cornell bans fraternity parties for the rest of the academic year amid investigation into alleged sexual assault
headlines.description: The university will also bring on “experienced, trauma-informed criminal investigators” to review allegations of sexual assault on campus.

headlines.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns as U.S. ambassador to Greece amid misconduct allegations
headlines.description: U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle, once a top Trump campaign surrogate, resigned amid misconduct allegations, which she said were false. Guilfoyle's announcement came shortly after the new White House press secretary, Katie Zacharia, told reporters that the ambassador was asked to step down.

headlines.title: Duane Davis sentenced to 40 years to life for 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur
headlines.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was sentenced to 40 years to life in connection to the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur. The sentence includes a 20-year mandatory enhancement for profiting off the murder. NBC News' Dana Griffin details what Tupac’s family said during the sentencing.

headlines.title: Diesel futures jump, signaling higher prices to come despite Trump’s Russia deal
headlines.description: “Absolutely stunning price spikes in wholesale diesel today,” a top energy analyst said.

headlines.title: What’s fueling inflation? Fuel.
headlines.description: Inflation in America is being powered by diesel.

headlines.title: Bryan Cranston mourns ‘Breaking Bad’ co-star RJ Mitte: ‘My sweet son’
headlines.description: The pair had been planning to get together for lunch before Mitte’s death by suicide, and Cranston lamented their inability to make that happen.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: NFL legend Terry Bradshaw says he realizes his TV career is ‘coming to an end’
headlines.description: Pro Football Hall of Famer and Fox broadcaster Terry Bradshaw told NBC News on Tuesday his television career ‘is coming to an end.’
